evals.prompt: how should we measure developer productivity
evals.expected_output: Instructs instrumenting the loop before optimizing anything: baseline time-to-first-commit, local build/test wall-clock time, CI queue time plus execution time separately, and deploy lead time, using DORA's four keys as a floor and adding local-loop metrics DORA misses.

evals.prompt: new hires take half a day just to get a local environment running
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses this as a setup-friction problem to fix directly: standardize on one documented path such as a devcontainer, Nix, or a single setup script so there is one command to a running app, treat any remaining manual step as a bug, and ensure parity with production config.

evals.prompt: let's write a script to automate this manual approval step
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that automating a broken process just makes the breakage run faster, and asks whether the approval should exist at all before scripting it away, per the cut-toil-before-automating-it step.
